notes: Sneak plus right-click with a wrench picks up a placed create:shaft into the inventory. TRUTH: WrenchItem.useOn: when isShiftKeyDown and canWrenchPickup(state), the block is removed and the item returned (create:shaft). The interact step holds sneak ("sneak": true): truth-ctl holds key.sneak down around the click, OURS passes horizon-ctl interact --sneak.
